headline: Premier League youngsters take eight Golden Boy places
summary: Arsenal's Myles Lewis-Skelly is among eight Premier League players on the 25-man shortlist for the 2026 Golden Boy award, which recognises Europe's best under-21 men's player. Sky Sports reports that Bournemouth, Brighton and Chelsea each have two nominees, with Manchester City's Ayyoub Bouaddi also included.
